claims.text: Less effective and more expensive than oral therapy, but an alternative first-line option for superficial or early distal lateral subungual disease (few adverse effects or interactions)
claims.quote: Although topical therapy is less effective and more expensive than oral therapy, it can be used as an alternative first-line treatment in patients with superficial onychomycosis or early distal lateral subungual onychomycosis because of low risks of adverse effects and minimal drug-drug interactions.

Two randomized controlled trials (RCTs) including 460 total patients showed that compared with vehicle, ciclopirox 8% is better at achieving complete cure at 48 weeks, although only the second study was statistically significant (study 1: 5.5% vs. 0.9%; P =.059 and study 2: 8.5% vs. 0%; P =.001).

claims.text: Efinaconazole and tavaborole penetrate the nail plate and beat older topicals;
claims.quote: Topical agents efinaconazole and tavaborole can penetrate the nail plate and are more effective than older topical agents.

claims.text: topical treatment works especially well in children (thinner, faster-growing nails)
claims.quote: Topical treatment is particularly effective in children due to their thinner and faster growing nails compared to adults.

claims.text: Adverse effects are mostly at the application site: exfoliation, erythema, burning, dermatitis
claims.quote: Adverse effects are generally limited to exfoliation, erythema, burning, and dermatitis at the application site.
